Page.Name: page.custom.popover
Page.Title: Popover
Page.Subtitle: Raven has popups for its menus, lists and pickers, but no popover holding any widget. Here: a Canvas laid over the window (main.xml, popover_layer) holds a Border whose contents are chosen by name; src/popover.c places it under the button that opened it, kept inside the window. A click elsewhere or Escape closes it.

Demo.Title: Popovers
Demo.Note: The contents are ordinary widgets: inputs, switches, combo boxes, even a date picker.
